buildings.name: Summoning Altar
buildings.description: Offer a Slab depicting a Pal to summon a powerful Pal to your base. Adequate caution and battle readiness is paramount.

buildings.name: Ancient Furnace
buildings.description: A special furnace based on ancient technology that can smelt all types of ingots. Materials are melted with fire, then quickly cooled and solidified using ice. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Cooling suitability.

buildings.name: Ancient Kitchen
buildings.description: A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes. It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.

buildings.name: Ancient Power Generator
buildings.description: A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology. It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation. It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.

buildings.name: Ancient Farm
buildings.description: A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island. Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots. It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.

buildings.name: Ancient Material Synthesizer
buildings.description: A special generator based on ancient technology that uses the power of the World Tree to produce all kinds of wood and ore. Due to its complex structure, only one Pal can be assigned to it.

buildings.name: Ancient Relic Recycler
buildings.description: An ancient civilization device that converts materials using repurposed technology from a lost civilization. It deciphers the technology left within Ancient Relics and refines them into new forms. A highly specialized facility designed for the efficient use of relics without waste.

buildings.name: Ancient Workbench
buildings.description: A Pal-exclusive workbench that is capable of crafting any item in one place. It cannot be used by the player, and operates at the same speed as a regular workbench. Due to its advanced equipment, it requires Pals with high-level Handiwork and Medicine Production suitability.

buildings.name: Ancient Clinic
buildings.description: A top-tier medical facility that reproduces advanced ancient medical technology. It offers significantly greater protective capability than a standard clinic. By assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability, even bases with harsh working conditions can maintain the highest level of hygiene.

buildings.name: Ancient Diagonal Wall
buildings.description: An angled wall built on triangular foundations to keep out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Wall and Door
buildings.description: Door built on a foundation. Becomes an entrance. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Fence
buildings.description: Fencing built on foundations and roofs for keeping out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Pal Bed
buildings.description: A ulitmate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress. It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue. It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.

buildings.name: Ancient Pillar
buildings.description: Column for structural support. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Pyramid Roof
buildings.description: A pyramidal roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Slanted Roof
buildings.description: Slanted roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Slanted Triangular Roof
buildings.description: A slanted triangular roof built on top of diagonal walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Slanted Triangular Roof (Inverted)
buildings.description: An inverted slanted triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Hot Spring
buildings.description: A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium. It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health. It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.

buildings.name: Ancient Triangular Foundation
buildings.description: A triangular foundation for building walls or facilities. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Triangular Roof
buildings.description: A triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Corner Roof
buildings.description: A corner roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Triangular Wall
buildings.description: Triangular wall built on a foundation to keep out intruders. Can be used to create create clean, futuristic architecture.

buildings.name: Ancient Triangular Wall (Inverted)
buildings.description: An inverted triangular wall built on a foundation to keep out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Pal Passage Entrance
buildings.description: An entrance to a Pal passage built on a foundation. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Wall and Window
buildings.description: Wall with windows, built on a foundation to keep out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.description: A foundation for building walls or facilities. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Roof
buildings.description: A roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Ancient Stairs

buildings.name: Ancient Wall
buildings.description: Walls built on foundations to keep out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

buildings.name: Japanese Paper Lantern
buildings.description: Decorative Paper Lantern. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

buildings.name: Arcade Game Cabinet
buildings.description: Decorative arcade machine. Broken, it can't be played.

buildings.name: Red Metal Barrel
buildings.description: Decorative red metal barrel.

buildings.name: Blue Metal Barrel
buildings.description: Decorative blue metal barrel.

buildings.name: Green Metal Barrel
buildings.description: Decorative green metal barrel.

buildings.name: Wooden Barrel
buildings.description: Wooden barrel for storing items.

buildings.name: Alarm Bell
buildings.description: Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base. Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies, or focus entirely on work whenever you like.

buildings.name: Item Retrieval Machine
buildings.description: A device that lets you freely access items from all chests in the base.

buildings.name: Monitoring Stand
buildings.description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

buildings.name: High Quality Monitoring Stand
buildings.description: A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure. In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base. Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

buildings.name: Ancient Monitoring Stand
buildings.description: A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium. It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals. A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.

buildings.name: Palbox Control Device
buildings.description: A remote-access terminal for the Palbox. Set it up wherever you'd like and build a base of your own design.

buildings.name: Antique Bathtub
buildings.description: Decorative antique bathtub.

buildings.name: Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner
buildings.description: Decorative Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner.

buildings.name: Free Pal Alliance Standard
buildings.description: Decorative Free Pal Alliance Standard.

buildings.name: Wooden Bench
buildings.description: Decorative wooden bench.

buildings.name: Primitive Furnace
buildings.description: Allows refinement of Ingot. The quality leaves much to desire, and processing is slow. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Improved Furnace
buildings.description: Allows refinement of Refined Ingot. The quality has improved, but the processing speed is still unsatisfactory. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Electric Furnace
buildings.description: Allows refinement of Pal Metal Ingot. It requires electricity to use, but is quicker to process. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Gigantic Furnace
buildings.description: Allows refinement of Hexolite. By growing in size, multiple Pals can collaborate to perform smelting. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Bonsai
buildings.description: Decorative Bonsai. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

buildings.name: Small Container
buildings.description: Small container for storing items.

buildings.name: Antique Braided Basket
buildings.description: Decorative antique braided basket.

buildings.name: Cloth Covered Container
buildings.description: Cloth covered container for storing items.

buildings.name: Wooden Box
buildings.description: Wooden box for storing items.

buildings.name: Breeding Farm
buildings.description: Assign one male and one female Pal to produce eggs. Placing Cake in the facility is required for production.

buildings.name: Statue of Power
buildings.description: Stone statue spoken of in legends on Palpagos Island. Offer up Lifmunk Effigy to receive strange powers.

buildings.name: Folding Screen
buildings.description: Decorative folding screen. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

buildings.name: Cable Reel
buildings.description: Decorative cable reel.

buildings.name: Campfire
buildings.description: Needed for cooking food. It can only be used to grill simple ingredients. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Majestic Candlestick
buildings.description: An imposing candlestick lit by the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre and revered as sacred. It can be placed on the ground. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Witch Cauldron
buildings.description: Place in base to improve medicine manufacturing speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

buildings.name: Ceiling Lamp
buildings.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. It can be placed on a ceiling. Requires electricity, but lights up a larger area.

buildings.name: Leather Chair
buildings.description: Decorative leather chair.

buildings.name: Frog Chair
buildings.description: Cute decorative chair.

buildings.name: Antique Wooden Chair
buildings.description: Decorative antique wooden chair.

buildings.name: Wooden Chair
buildings.description: Decorative wooden chair.

buildings.name: Iron Chair
buildings.description: Decorative wooden chair.

buildings.name: Antique Green Wooden Chair
buildings.description: Decorative antique green wooden chair.

buildings.name: Pal Essence Condenser
buildings.description: A chamber for increasing a Pal's rank. Pals can surpass their physical limitations if given a concentrated extract taken from a Pal of the same type.

buildings.name: Clinic
buildings.description: A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base. Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury. While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

buildings.name: Antique Grandfather Clock
buildings.description: Decorative antique grandfather clock. Broken, it doesn't tell time.

buildings.name: Wall Clock
buildings.description: Decorative wall clock. Broken, it doesn't tell time.

buildings.name: Coal Quarry
buildings.description: Facility for producing Coal. Digging Coal is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

buildings.name: Drafting Table
buildings.description: A facility that lets you combine multiple schematics to create more advanced ones.

buildings.name: Free Pal Alliance Flag
buildings.description: Decorative Free Pal Alliance flag.

buildings.name: Free Pal Alliance Horizontal Banner
buildings.description: Decorative Free Pal Alliance horizontal banner.

buildings.name: Large Container
buildings.description: Large container for storing items. Imitates the designs left behind by an ancient and prosperous civilization.

buildings.name: Cooking Pot
buildings.description: Needed for cooking food. Use of a cooking pot allows for a wider variety of meal preparation. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Cooler
buildings.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much relief from the heat, but helps one to endure somewhat hot environments. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

buildings.name: Cooler Box
buildings.description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

buildings.name: Cold Food Box
buildings.description: A feeding box that can be kept cold. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

buildings.name: Ore Mining Site
buildings.description: Facility for producing Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

buildings.name: Ore Mining Site II
buildings.description: Facility for producing large quantities of Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

buildings.name: Wooden Counter
buildings.description: Decorative wooden counter.

buildings.name: Crusher
buildings.description: Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials. Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

buildings.name: Hexolite Quartz Mine
buildings.description: Facility for producing Hexolite Quartzs. Digging Hexolite Quartzs is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

buildings.name: Antique Curtain
buildings.description: Decorative antique curtain. Can be placed on walls.

buildings.name: Training Dummy
buildings.description: Training dummy shaped like a Pengullet. Can only be placed in wide open areas.

buildings.name: Feybreak Banner
buildings.description: Decorative Feybreak banner.

buildings.name: Feybreak Flag
buildings.description: Decorative Feybreak flag.

buildings.name: Tuppanyan sticker
buildings.description: en Text

buildings.name: Mounted Crossbow
buildings.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a crossbow.

buildings.name: Mounted Machine Gun
buildings.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a machine gun.

buildings.name: Ancient Turret
buildings.description: An unmanned turret of ancient technology equipped with rocket launcher–level size and firepower. It requires no ammunition or Pal assignment, and performs fully automated interception using only electricity. However, despite its immense power, it requires a massive amount of electricity to operate.

buildings.name: Mounted Missile Launcher
buildings.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a missile launcher.

buildings.name: Sandbag
buildings.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal is assigned, it will stop other work and stay on lookout and prepare for combat.

buildings.name: Stone Defensive Wall
buildings.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

buildings.name: Metal Defensive Wall
buildings.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

buildings.name: Wooden Defensive Wall
buildings.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from wood, it breaks easily.

buildings.name: Iron Desk
buildings.description: Decorative iron desk.

buildings.name: Antique Desk
buildings.description: Decorative antique desk.

buildings.name: Dimensional Pal Storage
buildings.description: A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals. Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals. If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

buildings.name: Pal Disassembly Conveyor
buildings.description: A dream-like facility that automatically butchers any Pal that is placed inside.

buildings.name: Viewing Cage
buildings.description: Container for observing captured Pals. Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.

buildings.name: Electric Cooler
buildings.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really lower the temperature. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

buildings.name: Power Generator
buildings.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Electric equipment won't run without this.

buildings.name: Large Power Generator
buildings.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Larger and with improved power generation efficiency.

buildings.name: Electric Egg Incubator
buildings.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. Requires electricity, but automatically keeps the inside of the incubator at appropriate temperatures.

buildings.name: Electric Heater
buildings.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really heat things up. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Electric Kitchen
buildings.description: Needed for cooking food. It requires electricity to run, but allows a large amount of meals to be prepared rapidly. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

buildings.name: Accumulator
buildings.description: A facility for storing excess electricity generated by the Power Generator.

buildings.name: Pal Expedition Station
buildings.description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

buildings.name: High-Quality Workbench
buildings.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. A small workspace limits production speeds. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Production Assembly Line
buildings.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Production Assembly Line II
buildings.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Advanced Workshop
buildings.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed production. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

buildings.name: Gold Coin Assembly Line
buildings.description: An Assembly Line that manufactures Gold Coin. The work puts a strain on the mind, causing a decrease in Pal's SAN value. Requires Pals that can work with their hands. Warning: building this facility may draw severe scrutiny from the PIDF.

buildings.name: Berry Plantation
buildings.description: A farm that can grow Red Berries. Harvest time is quick, but eating them doesn't provide much sustenance. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Carrot Plantation
buildings.description: A farm where you can grow Carrot. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

buildings.name: Lettuce Plantation

buildings.name: Tomato Plantation

buildings.name: Wheat Plantation
buildings.description: A farm that can grow Wheat. It requires an average amount of time to harvest. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest crops.

buildings.name: Skillfruit Orchard
buildings.description: A farm where Skillfruits can be cultivated. By planting the original fruit in the ground, multiple fruits of the same type can be harvested.

buildings.name: Great Eagle Statue
